title: Bain karti thi sakina ke aao baba
body:
BAIN KARTI THI SAKINA KE AB AAO BABA, SHUMR KE ZULM SE BETI KO BACHAO BABA
SAR SE KEHTI THI SAKINA NA RULAO BABA, TASHT SE JALD MERI GOAD MEIN AAO BABA
BABAJAAN DEKHIYE TOH PUSHT ZARA BETI KI, PAIRAHAN LIPTA HAI ZAKHMAON SE CHUDHAO BABA
HAIN KAHAAN AAP KA SEENA MUJHE NEEND AATI HAI, KAB SE MAIN DOOR HOON SEENE PE SULAO BABA
<<DIVIDER>>
SAAMNE MERE BAHA DETE HAIN PAANI ZALIM, TASHNA LAB HOON MAIN CHACHA JAAN KO LAO BABA
AANKHEN DIKHLAKE DARATA HAI YEH HARWAQT MUJHE, ISKO MARENGE CHACHA JAAN KO LAO BABA
MAARDETA HAIN TAMACHA JO MAIN ROTI HOON KABHI, TANG HOON JEENE SE PAAS APNE BULAO BABA
GOADMEIN JAAKE KAHA SAR NE SAKINA SE NAGEEN, HASHR HO JAYEGA BAS SABR DIKHAO BABA
